sections.content: You know *es importante que* + subjunctive from A2 Unit 27, and *es necesario que*, *hace falta que* and *conviene que* from B1 Unit 18. Here you use them to say what must be done about a problem.

items.spanish: Es necesario que actuemos para que el problema no se agrave.
items.english: It is necessary that we act so that the problem does not get worse.

items.spanish: Hace falta que las autoridades prevengan nuevas averías.
items.english: The authorities need to prevent new breakdowns.

items.spanish: Es importante que abordemos la causa del problema.
items.english: It is important that we address the cause of the problem.

items.spanish: Conviene que se adopten medidas antes del invierno.
items.english: It is advisable that measures be adopted before winter.

sections.content: After *para que*, which you know from B1 Unit 4, the subjunctive also says the aim: *actuemos para que el problema no se agrave*.
